journey.name: TH-01 Dark mode keeps the priority colours apart
journey.description:
Covers FR-14 and backlog tasks TB-705 and TB-706. The priority palette has a separate dark set because the light one does not survive inversion: on a dark surface the three dots must still read as three different ranks, and the overdue date must still read as a warning rather than as body text.
Priority is conveyed by text as well as colour (NFR-09), so the labels are checked in the layout dump and the colours by eye from a screenshot. A palette that fails here fails for colour-blind users in light mode too.
Preconditions: adb shell cmd uimode night yes adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0
Afterwards: adb shell cmd uimode night no

actions.action: Verify from a screenshot that the app is rendered on a dark background
Verify that elements with the content descriptions "High", "Medium" and "Low" are all on screen
Verify from a screenshot that the priority indicators for High, Medium and Low are three visibly different colours
Verify from a screenshot that "Due yesterday" is rendered in a colour distinct from "Due in 3 days"
Verify from a screenshot that every task title is legible against the dark background
Tap the element with the content description "Add task"
Verify from a screenshot that the priority chips are legible and that the selected chip is distinguishable from the unselected ones
